| description = Will [[Harm Touch]], but doesn't cast other Shadow Knight spells.

These oddballs are found in Field of Bone's undead tunnels: one on each side of [[Gharg Oberbord]] and two sitting on the graves across from him. Despite appearing as guards, they will not assist [[Gharg Oberbord]] and he will not assist them. They also don't assist [[A skeletal jester]], but they will assist other guardians and any [[servant of Sythrax | servants of Sythrax]] who come close.

They are also quite good hunts for exping Necromancers and Enchanters. [[Dominate Undead]] or [[Beguile]] and let them [[Harm Touch]] each other. Pull to the back of the room to avoid the [[servant of Sythrax]] that patrols in through the door every minute or so. Since they are not inherently aggressive, Necromancers can [[Feign Death]] and Enchanters can [[Mesmerize]] / [[Memory Blur]] to reset in case things go south.
